RFC5549-4-1.note: Independent Section 4 rejudgment retains enforced for this superseded RFC8950-4-1 obligation. TestNegotiateExtendedNextHop and TestNegotiateExtendedNextHopMismatch establish advertised tuple intersection and remote absence. The tagged canUseNextHopFor, self and explicit-next-hop tests distinguish the exact 1/1 and 1/128 tuples, including wrong-pair and absent refusal. TestRFC8950ExplicitIPv6NextHopFollowsTheNegotiatedPair installs the same real negotiated result in Session, Peer and send context and checks API refusal with no unlicensed unicast UPDATE. VPN assertions in that test remain resolver assertions, not VPN socket assertions. Negotiate projects the exact tuple to EncodingCaps; resolveNextHop/canUseNextHopFor and both forwarding consumers use that pair. The successor’s separately tagged forwarding and post-policy final-writer tests provide the shared integration evidence. No stale producer-halt record is treated as selective semantic proof.

RFC5549-4-2.note: Row single-polarity positive, superseded by RFC8950-4-2. TestRFC8950PeerSupportDecidedPerPair proves peer support is decided per NLRI pair through the Extended Next Hop capability negotiation (Negotiated and EncodingCaps). The negative tag moved off the RFC8950 negative (approval D-15), consistent with the row's single-polarity marker.

RFC5549-4-3.note: Forbidden: a Capability Code other than 5 for Extended Next Hop Encoding. Red on it: TestCapabilityCodeConstants asserts uint8(CodeExtendedNextHop)==5, and TestExtendedNextHopCapability requires a raw code-0x05 TLV to parse as *ExtendedNextHop (require.True on the type assertion). Single-polarity marker on the row.

RFC5549-4-4.note: Independently rejudged the same Section 4 MUST-only-advertise sentence, not an invented separate MUST NOT clause. Tagged explicit/self matrices distinguish 1/1, 1/128 and neither; canUseNextHopFor tests reject absent and nil capability state and permit the licensed tuple. The explicit API test aligns actual Session and Peer negotiated state and observes ErrNextHopIncompatible with no UPDATE for unlicensed unicast. Shared RFC8950 successor evidence covers forwarding and post-policy writer admission. The positive ExtNH tag now accurately names the MUST-only-advertise condition. Retain the duplicate/superseded disposition and renew the changed claim’s native record; the former panic binding is not selective semantic proof.

RFC5549-5-1.note: Forbidden: a route reflector changing the encoding of a next hop it passes along unchanged. Red on it: require.Equal(mpReach, attrs[14]) and the next-hop byte compare in TestReactorForwardRRPreservesExtendedNextHop, which reflects a 16-byte IPv6 next hop for IPv4 NLRI through the reactor forward path. Single-polarity marker on the row.
